daily.today_energy: Your emotional radar is finely tuned today. Trust those gut feelings pulling you toward authenticity. This is peak energy for releasing what no longer serves your peace—journal it out, cry it out, whatever feels real.
daily.love: Someone's been thinking about you more than you realize. Whether single or coupled, there's a softness in the air inviting deeper conversations. Let vulnerability be your superpower today; it's actually magnetic.
daily.career: Your intuition about a project or decision is basically screaming at you. This isn't the day to play it safe or wait for permission. Your unique perspective is exactly what's needed right now.
daily.health: Your nervous system's asking for a reset. Slow down enough to actually feel your body—whether that's stretching, a long shower, or just sitting outside. Nourish yourself like you'd care for someone you love.

weekly.overview: This week, your intuition is basically your cheat code. The cosmos wants you to trust those gut feelings that have been whispering to you. Something's shifting in your favor, even if it doesn't look obvious yet. Lean into the mystery.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or single, vulnerability is your superpower right now. Let people see the real, messy version of you. The right energy will match it. Stop performing and start connecting.
weekly.career: Your ideas deserve to take up space this week. You've been sitting on something good—pitch it, share it, whatever. The universe is backing your creative moves. Trust your instincts over overthinking.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness, not punishment. This is the week to lean into rest without guilt. Movement that feels good (not forced) is calling to you. Listen to what your system actually needs.
